extension.description: Build literature reviews for the social sciences by handing them to your AI agent: it searches Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex, screens, fills in the paper cards and writes; you review and correct from the sidebar. No terminal needed.
view.surveys.name: Surveys
welcome.noWorkspace:
Priorwork keeps each literature review in a workspace: a folder (and a private Git repository) with the reports and their state.
[Create a Workspace](command:priorwork.initWorkspace)
Already have one? Open its folder.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Diagnose the Setup](command:priorwork.doctor)
welcome.noSurveys:
No surveys yet. The easiest way: give the topic and let your agent (Claude Code, Antigravity, …) do the survey.
[Start a Survey](command:priorwork.newSurvey)
Set your API keys first for faster searches.
[Open the Settings](command:priorwork.openSettings)
config.command: The `priorwork` command. Empty: the workspace's `.venv`, then `priorwork` on `PATH`.
config.python: The Python used to create a workspace's `.venv`. Empty: `python3` (`py -3` on Windows).
config.autoAdvance: After a decision on the paper page, move on to the next unscreened paper.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Priorwork
walkthrough.description: Set up a workspace and hand your first survey to your agent.
walkthrough.workspace.title: Create a workspace
walkthrough.workspace.description:
A workspace is a folder that holds your reports and the state of each survey. Keep it in a private GitHub repository.
[Create a Workspace](command:priorwork.initWorkspace)
walkthrough.keys.title: Set your API keys
walkthrough.keys.description:
A free Semantic Scholar API key makes searches much faster; Zotero is optional.
[Open the Settings](command:priorwork.openSettings)
walkthrough.survey.title: Ask your agent for a survey
walkthrough.survey.description:
Choose New Survey → Ask your agent to do it, give the topic, and paste the request into your agent's chat. You can also just tell the agent "review the literature on …". It sets the scope, searches, screens, fills in the cards, writes and checks without stopping.
[New Survey](command:priorwork.newSurvey)
walkthrough.screen.title: Review what the agent did
walkthrough.screen.description:
Read the report for reading, then check the decisions and cards on the paper pages. Overturn any decision (keys I, M, X) or correct a card; the agent follows your changes next time.
[Export and View the Report](command:priorwork.exportReport)
walkthrough.agent.title: Ask for more
walkthrough.agent.description: Right-click a survey → Ask Your Agent… to have it carry on, search more, chase citations, fill in cards or fix the check. If you want to decide on each paper yourself, tell the agent to go through it together with you.
